noticias.titulo: Analysis-October dive for AI-related shares tests broader US stock market's resilience
noticias.resumo:
The broader ‌market in October held up far better than tech- and AI-exposed equities did, but it may not be able to endure a more severe pullback in the massive AI trade.  The tech sector alone accounts for a 38% weight in the ​S&P 500. 

Investors are wary of signs that the selling will spread.
